message.text:
The persistent entities in the store package are User, Memo, Attachment, Reaction, Inbox, MemoRelation, MemoShare, and UserIdentity.

Additional persistent entities include UserSetting, IdentityProvider, InstanceSetting, and possibly AuthenticationConfigState. The search scope excludes store, store/db/*, store/test, and store/cache. Package counts will be tallied across server/router, server/auth, server/runner, cmd/memos, and internal directories. Each reference is counted per Go package, not per file.

References to entity types are identified by names like `store.User` or `store.Memo`. Proto-generated types such as `storepb.IdentityProvider` may also count as data-layer entities. The tally will exclude migration packages. Initial targets include `cmd/memos`, `server`, and `server/auth`.

The search now includes `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/mcp`, `server/runner/s3presign`, `server/runner/memopayload`, and `internal/*`. A script will tally unique packages referencing each entity, with separate counts for test packages.

args.command:
# Persistent entity types (core stored objects, not Find/Update/Delete helpers)
types="User Memo Attachment Reaction Inbox MemoRelation MemoShare UserIdentity UserSetting IdentityProvider InstanceSetting"

# List all go packages as directories containing .go files, excluding store layer and proto/gen
# Data layer: store, store/db/*, store/test, store/cache, store/migration, store/seed

echo "=== Package counts (excluding store layer, proto/gen, web) ==="
for t in $types; do
  echo "---- store.$t ----"
  # Find files mentioning store.Type as a type reference
  files=$(grep -rl --include="*.go" -E "store\\.${t}\\b" /bench/repo \
    --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=proto \
    | grep -v "^/bench/repo/store/" || true)
  echo "$files" | sed 's#/bench/repo/##' | head -80
  # unique packages = unique parent dirs
  echo -n "PACKAGES: "
  echo "$files" | while read f; do
    [ -z "$f" ] && continue
    dirname "$f"
  done | sort -u | wc -l
  echo "PACKAGE LIST:"
  echo "$files" | while read f; do
    [ -z "$f" ] && continue
    dirname "$f" | sed 's#/bench/repo/##'
  done | sort -u
  echo
done

Frontend is counted as a package referencing store.User and store.Memo, even though those references appear only in tests.

Excluding test files, User is referenced by 5 non-test packages and Memo by 4. Including test files raises both counts to 7 and 6. Fileserver also references User.

No other persistent entity types were found. Role is not a persistent entity. internal/webhook uses v1pb.Memo instead of store.Memo. FindUser and similar methods reference different types and are excluded. The final tallies are 5–7 for User and 4–6 for Memo.

Attachment ranks third with four external references. Store is not a persistent entity. Proto types such as storepb.InstanceSetting may also count as data-layer entities. Their usage is being verified.
